summary: Catalina expects AI to take over much human labor and writes about keeping AI clearly a tool, proof of personhood and protecting human contact.

statements.quote: the system must signal clearly that it is a tool. it must maintain artificial cues & avoid emotional dependency loops.
automation reduces the number of default human touchpoints in a normal week.
statements.venue: X Article, third places are critical infrastructure for a post automation society

statements.quote: anthropomorphizing models trains people to trust interfaces instead of incentives. that confusion compounds fast in agentic systems.
ASI-level automation replaces labor as the core mechanism that sustains society.
but the lines will continue to blur & fast. proof of personhood becoming increasingly necessary.
